title: Beeswax lip balm
subtitle: A firm, moisturising lip balm in a small tin or tube
excerpt: A beeswax lip balm made with sweet almond oil and a little castor oil for gloss. Flavoured with peppermint essential oil. Fills four 5 g lip balm tubes or one small tin. Sets firm at room temperature; melts on contact with the lips. Shelf life 12 months.
sourceNotes: Lip balm formulation: beeswax sets the stick/balm firmness; sweet almond oil (emollient) carries the formulation; castor oil adds gloss and helps the stick glide. Typical ratio for a firm lip balm stick: ~25% beeswax, ~60% sweet almond oil, ~15% castor oil by weight. Peppermint EO flavour: 0.5-1% maximum in a lip balm to avoid irritation on mucous membranes. Batch: 20 g total fills four standard 5 g lip balm tubes.

recipe.yieldDescription: ~20 g balm (four 5 g lip balm tubes or one small tin)
recipe.batchNotes: Doubles cleanly. Pour into a small jug with a pouring spout for the neatest tube fill.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready to use once set. Keeps 12 months in a cool, dark place.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 12 months. Anhydrous balm; no preservative needed. Discard if the balm smells rancid (oxidised almond oil).

glossaryTerms.definition: A preparation with no water phase. Anhydrous balms need no preservative because there is no moisture for micro-organisms to colonise.
A thick, sticky carrier oil used in lip balms and lipsticks for its gloss and slip. A small percentage (10-15%) in this recipe gives the balm a slightly glossy finish on the lips.

content.text: Stand the empty lip balm tubes upright in a jar or small container, caps off.
Combine the beeswax, sweet almond oil, and castor oil in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water. Stir until the beeswax is completely melted.
Remove from heat. Stir in the peppermint essential oil. Pour immediately, the mix sets quickly as it cools.
Leave undisturbed for 30 minutes until fully set. If a small dip forms at the top, give a tiny top-up pour of remaining liquid balm.
Store in a cool, dark place. This
balm keeps 12 months. Discard if it smells of oxidised oil, sweet almond oil can go rancid after a year.
